description: This source file implements functionalities related to handling Git tree objects, including decoding, initializing, and traversing tree entries, as well as pathspec matching and symlink following within a Git repository context.

classes.name: struct tree_desc
classes.description: Represents a tree object description used for iteration and decoding of tree entries.

classes.name: struct name_entry
classes.description: Represents individual entries within a tree, including path, mode, and object ID.

classes.name: struct traverse_info
classes.description: Holds information for traversing Git trees, including path, depth, and callback functions.

classes.name: struct tree_desc_skip
classes.description: Linked list node for skipping processed entries during extended tree traversal.

classes.name: struct tree_desc_x
classes.description: Extended tree descriptor that includes skipping state for advanced traversal.

classes.name: struct dir_state
classes.description: Maintains state for directory traversal, including object data, size, and object ID.

methods.name: int decode_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,const char * buf,unsigned long size,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Decodes a single entry from raw tree object buffer into the tree descriptor.

methods.description: Initializes a tree descriptor with provided object ID and buffer, decoding as needed.

methods.description: Initializes a tree descriptor and dies on error.

methods.description: Initializes a tree descriptor with error reporting instead of termination.

methods.name: void * fill_tree_descriptor(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Reads a tree object and initializes a tree descriptor, returning the object buffer.

methods.name: void entry_clear(struct name_entry * a)
methods.description: Resets a name_entry structure to zero.

methods.name: void entry_extract(struct tree_desc * t,struct name_entry * a)
methods.description: Copies the current entry from a tree descriptor into a name_entry.

methods.name: int update_tree_entry_internal(struct tree_desc * desc,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Updates the current tree descriptor entry after modifications.

methods.name: void update_tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc)
methods.description: Wraps internal update and dies on failure.

methods.name: int update_tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc)
methods.description: Updates tree entry with error reporting, returns status.

methods.name: int tree_entry(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Retrieves the current tree entry, updating it beforehand.

methods.name: int tree_entry_gently(struct tree_desc * desc,struct name_entry * entry)
methods.description: Same as tree_entry, but handles update errors gracefully.

methods.name: void setup_traverse_info(struct traverse_info * info,const char * base)
methods.description: Initializes traversal information structure for walking trees.

methods.name: char * make_traverse_path(char * path,size_t pathlen,const struct traverse_info * info,const char * name,size_t namelen)
methods.description: Constructs a traverse path string from path components and traversal info.

methods.description: Builds a traverse path in a strbuf.

methods.description: Recursively traverses multiple trees in a repository following various rules.
